title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Asset
description: Something which is placed inside of a building, but is not an integral part of that building's structure; e.g., furniture, equipment, systems, etc. (rec:Asset, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific REC asset class (Desk, Chair, IAQSensorEquipment, NetworkRouter, Door, Window, ...) is carried in recClass. Brick equipment classes (brick:Equipment and its ~220 subclasses, which REC places under Asset) are covered by the brick-schema candidate's Equipment model instead.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Asset'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable name (REC 'name' in DTDL, rdfs:label in the SHACL source).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item. Not a REC term.

identifiers.description: Property. Map of external identifiers for this entity, keyed by the namespace/system that issued them (REC 'identifiers', DTDL Map<string,string>).

customTags.description: Property. Map of free-form boolean tags (REC 'customTags', DTDL Map<string,boolean>).

customProperties.description: Property. Namespaced extension properties: a map from namespace to a map of property name to string value (REC 'customProperties', DTDL Map<string,Map<string,string>>).

recClass.description: Relationship. The specific RealEstateCore class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. REC 4.1 declares 61 non-deprecated classes in the rec:Asset hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: AccessPanel; ArchitecturalAsset; Asset; AudioVisualEquipment; BarrierAsset; Bed; Bookcase; BulletinBoard; Cart; Chair; CoatRack; CoffeeTable; ComputerCart; ConferenceTable; Controller; DataNetworkEquipment; DaylightSensorEquipment (Daylight Sensor); Desk; DeskLamp; Door; EndTable; EthernetPort; EthernetSwitch; FilingCabinet; FloorLamp; FloorMat; FoldingChair; FoldingTable; Footrest; Furniture; Gateway; IAQSensorEquipment (Indoor Air Quality Sensor); ICTEquipment; ICTHardware; ITRack; Lamp; LeakDetectorEquipment (Leak Detector); MailroomCart; MobileDesk; NetworkRouter; NetworkSecurityEquipment; OccupancySensorEquipment (Occupancy Sensor); OfficeChair; Partition; PeopleCountSensorEquipment (People Count Sensor); PrinterCart; PrinterStand; ReceptionTable; Safe; SensorEquipment; Server; Sofa; Stand; StorageCabinet; TVStand; Table; ThermostatEquipment (Thermostat); VibrationSensorEquipment (Vibration Sensor); WasteBasket; Window; WirelessAccessPoint. Excluded because REC 4.1 release notes deprecate them: BACnetController, ModbusController.

location.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON geometry of the item (RFC 7946). Corresponds to REC's 'geometry' (a GeoJSON Geometry; 'Polygon representing the spatial extent of this Space' / 'the position or extent of the asset'), carried in the NGSI-LD core 'location' attribute instead of a separate Geometry information object.

locatedIn.description: Relationship. Spaces (Site, Building, Level, Room, Zone) in which this asset is located (rec:locatedIn; optional since REC 4.1).

mountedOn.description: Relationship. The BuildingElement this asset is mounted on, e.g. a camera on a wall (SHACL maxCount 1).

hasPart.description: Relationship. Assets that are parts of this asset.

isPartOf.description: Relationship. Assets this asset is part of.

hasPoint.description: Relationship. Brick Points exposed by this asset -- see the brick-schema candidate's Point and sensor models.

IPAddress.description: Property. IP address (rec:IPAddress; name kept verbatim, including its upper-case initial).

MACAddress.description: Property. MAC address (rec:MACAddress; name kept verbatim).

colour.description: Property. Colour of the asset, for visual identification (rec:colour, new in REC 4.1).

weight.description: Property. Weight of the asset (rec:weight). SHACL types it xsd:decimal, the 4.1 DTDL as string; a number is used here. Units:'KGM' recommended -- REC states none.

initialCost.description: Property. Initial cost of the asset, as free text including currency, e.g. '1200 EUR' (rec:initialCost, a string in REC).

maintenanceInterval.description: Property. Maintenance interval as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P6M' (rec:maintenanceInterval, xsd:duration).

heightRUs.description: Property. Height in rack units; applies to ICTEquipment subclasses (rec:heightRUs).

numberOfPorts.description: Property. Number of ports; applies to ICTEquipment subclasses (rec:numberOfPorts).

standard.description: Property. Standard the equipment adheres to, e.g. 'IEEE 802.11'; applies to ICTEquipment subclasses (rec:standard).

manufacturedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that manufactured this asset.

installedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that installed this asset.

commissionedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that commissioned this asset.

servicedBy.description: Relationship. Agents that service this asset.

warranty.description: Relationship. Warranty events (rec:Warranty, new in REC 4.1) covering this asset. Warranty is not modelled as a separate entity in this candidate.

documentation.description: Relationship. Documents describing this entity (rec:Document, e.g. manuals, drawings, contracts), as URIs.
